script_text: Something is fundamentally shifting in your cosmic blueprint this week. Career tensions dissolve instantly as Jupiter sextile Mars awakens your professional ambition, making the weekend incredibly rewarding. Thursday is your ultimate power day because Jupiter enters your 7th House. Tuesday remains your worst day due to Saturn squaring your 10th House.
